tagline: Turn your site into a survey plan you can inspect and keep

examples.prompt: Use my orchard boundary GeoJSON and camera measurements to plan a photo survey. Keep the pond excluded, show the ground sampling and each camera footprint, and divide the work into sorties that include a return. Give me editable files and a field report.
examples.caption: Alder Orchard · editable capture plan; example geometry

examples.prompt: This work site is L-shaped and has two equipment areas to avoid. Compare capture directions and revise the equipment exclusion without moving the approved storage compound. Export a GIS layer and capture table I can review.
examples.caption: Works Yard · original boundary and exclusion geometry

examples.prompt: Compare this recorded CSV with the revised survey plan. I will map the time, altitude units and camera-event columns. Show missing samples and estimated event footprints, and retain my original data with the report.
examples.caption: Estuary Plots · evidence workflow using a synthetic CSV fixture
